excludes: facts with source.type=derived or confidence=low (not confirmable in the manufacturer PDF)

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch1-in
facts.description: Channel 1's input is normalled to a +5V DC source, so the channel is an offset generator when unpatched.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch2-in
facts.description: Channel 2's input is normalled to +8V DC — a different normal from Channel 1, which is the module's main trap.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch3-a-in
facts.description: Channel 3's A input is normalled to ground rather than to a voltage, unlike Channels 1 and 2.

facts.subject: channel-saver
facts.description: All three channels are normalled to a SUM and an Inverted SUM bus through their own output jacks.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch1-out
facts.description: Patching Channel 1's output takes that channel out of both the SUM and Inverted SUM buses.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch2-out
facts.description: Patching Channel 2's output takes that channel out of both the SUM and Inverted SUM buses.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch1-atten
facts.value: -5V to +5V DC offset with Channel 1 Input unpatched
facts.description: With no external signal the attenuverter scales and inverts the +5V normal into a bipolar offset.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch2-atten
facts.value: -8V to +8V DC offset with Channel 2 Input unpatched
facts.description: Channel 2 reaches a wider offset than Channel 1 purely because its normal is +8V rather than +5V.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch3-xfade
facts.value: acts as a plain non-inverting attenuator on the B input while the A input is unpatched
facts.description: The 0V normal on the A input turns the crossfader into an attenuator, per the manual's panel notes.

facts.subject: duatt-1u/in-a
facts.description: With no cable in IN A the module feeds Channel A an internal 5V DC source.

facts.subject: duatt-1u/in-b
facts.description: With no cable in IN B the module feeds Channel B an internal 5V DC source.

facts.subject: duatt-1u/out-a
facts.description: Unpatched, Channel A's output voltage is bussed to Channel B and summed with it, so OUT B carries A+B.

facts.subject: duatt-1u/out-a
facts.description: Patching OUT A removes Channel A from the sum at OUT B; the two channels then run independently.

facts.subject: duatt-1u/in-a
facts.description: The Ax2 switch doubles whatever is at IN A, including the internal normal, giving a switchable DC offset source.

facts.subject: duatt-1u/atten-a

value.uni: 0V at full CCW to the full input value at full CW
value.bipolar: inverted input at full CCW, 0V at noon, full input at full CW

facts.description: The polarity switch decides whether the knob attenuates or attenuverts, over a patched signal or over the normal.

facts.subject: duatt-1u/out-a
facts.value: +2.5V with IN A unpatched, polarity UNI and the attenuator at noon
facts.description: Inferred by applying the stated half-voltage-at-noon behaviour of the UNI attenuator to the stated +5V normal.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuverter-in
facts.description: The attenuverter input carries an internal 5V when no cable is inserted, so the knob becomes a bipolar offset.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuator-in
facts.description: The attenuator input carries the same internal 5V when no cable is inserted, feeding the fader.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuator-out
facts.description: Left unpatched, the attenuator output is mixed at unity gain into the attenuverter output.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuator-out
facts.value: cable inserted in the attenuator output (4)
facts.description: Patching output (4) takes it out of the internal unity-gain mix, splitting the module into two utilities.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuverter-out
facts.description: With both outputs used separately and nothing patched in, output (2) is a bipolar manual voltage source.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuator-out
facts.description: Used separately, output (4) is a unipolar manual voltage source driven by the fader over the 5V normal.

facts.subject: navigator/attenuverter-out
facts.value: -5V to +10V with nothing patched anywhere, as the two normalled paths sum at unity
facts.description: Inferred by combining the two stated 5V normals with the stated unity-gain mix; the manual gives no combined range.
